$comment: Mission 1.77. Why the reviewed Wikimedia reliability scopes are historically known to resolve while the Opportunity-linked production path reported every row NON_SCORABLE. Authoritative where paired with the generated Markdown. Every number here is cross-checked by the gate against docs/data/reliability-resource-binding-diagnostic-v1.json, which is measured from the live deployment by infrastructure/scripts/report_reliability_resource_binding.py.

diagnostic.operator_gate_not_ci_gate: the script reads a deployment; CI starts from an empty database (Mission 1.37 §22)

why_this_outcome: Mission 1.76 diagnosed that 'resource_id is absent from the whole acquisition lineage' and proposed binding the Wikimedia lineage to a committed collector constant. The first statement is false on the held data: every one of the 325 RawRecords carries provenance.resource_id, reachable from any Evidence row through its Signal's inputs, and the real resolver resolves all 36 Wikimedia rows through that join with no source named anywhere. The proposed repair was therefore unnecessary, and it is the hard-coded source exception section 10 forbids. What was actually wrong is a different defect that 1.76 did not name: the Opportunity production path never resolves reliability at all. It reads scoring.evidence.reliability, which ADR-026 Decision 2 keeps NULL by design, so every row of every source read NON_SCORABLE whatever the reviewed assessments said, TED included.
why_not_REPAIRED: REPAIRED would name Wikimedia and name a scope binding, and neither is what was broken: the binding existed in the data from acquisition, and the defect repaired here is generic and sits in the consumer. Reporting REPAIRED would confirm the misdiagnosis in the outcome name. The seventeen success criteria of section 27 are nevertheless recorded one by one below, because they are all met and hiding that would be the opposite error.
secondary_findings: OPPORTUNITY_PATH_DID_NOT_RESOLVE_LATE, repaired generically in both Opportunity runners
OPPORTUNITY_LIMITATION_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED: the canonical revision-1 limitation is stale and was not edited

production_failure_frozen.how_it_derived_reliability_before: SELECT e.reliability; reliability_status = RESOLVED if the column is non-null else NO_APPLICABLE_ASSESSMENT. No ReliabilityScope is constructed and resolve_reliability is never called.
production_failure_frozen.PRODUCTION_SCOPE_BEFORE: NONE: the path constructs no five-part scope for any row
production_failure_frozen.RESOLVER_RESULT_BEFORE: NOT_INVOKED: every row reads NO_APPLICABLE_ASSESSMENT from a NULL column, for all five sources
production_failure_frozen.MISSING_SCOPE_FACT: none. The path asks for no fact at all; what is missing is the late resolution ADR-026 Decision 2 requires. The fact 1.76 called missing, the resource, is persisted on every RawRecord.
production_failure_frozen.reproducible_by_code: the diagnostic's per-row scorable_via_stored_column counter is 0 of 58 and its evidence_reliability_written counter is 0, before and after

mission_1_76_audit_path.rows_where_that_key_exists: 17 of 44 Claims, all TED, World Bank and GDELT kinds; 0 of 25 Wikimedia and Stack Exchange kinds
mission_1_76_audit_path.why_absent_there: ADR-035 and ADR-036 keep the resource out of proposition identity for the kinds that converge; a proposition fact says WHAT is asserted and the resource says WHICH measurement produced the witness
mission_1_76_audit_path.result: scope None for 46 rows, so the resolver reported that the row cannot state its measurement-and-purpose scope; 12 TED rows resolved
mission_1_76_audit_path.what_1_76_wrote: resource_id is absent from the whole acquisition lineage and appears only in the assessment and, for other sources, inside proposition_facts
mission_1_76_audit_path.status_of_that_sentence: FALSE. acquisition.raw_records.provenance.resource_id is present on 325 of 325 records, including all 21 Wikimedia records. The narrower sentence in the 1.76 report, that the lineage carries no resource_id COLUMN, is true and was generalised into the false one.

historical_apparent_contradiction.how_they_built_the_scope: r.provenance ->> 'resource_id' through nlp.signal_inputs, acquisition.normalized_records and acquisition.raw_records, with LIMIT 1
historical_apparent_contradiction.PATH_DIFFERENCE: 1.36.1 and 1.44.1 read the resource from acquisition provenance through signal lineage; 1.76 read it from proposition facts, which carry it for some kinds and not others; the Opportunity runners read neither and resolved nothing.
historical_apparent_contradiction.ROOT_CAUSE: two defects, neither of them a missing fact. (1) The Opportunity path performs no late resolution, so its scorability report is a report about a NULL column. (2) Mission 1.76's diagnostic reconstructed the scope from the wrong layer and generalised the absence it found there to the whole lineage.

both_claims_true.opportunity_path_could_not_bind: true of the path, which binds nothing; false of the lineage, which binds everything

was_mission_1_76_wrong.not_on_what: the priority finding that a reviewed assessment exists and that the corpus is one deterministic step from scorable evidence; that step exists and was the consumer's, not the data's

historical_apparent_contradiction.historical_resolution_was_the_same_rule_: the two historical scripts and this mission read the same persisted fact; what this mission adds is the rule as a named function that refuses ambiguity instead of taking the first row, and its use on the production path

could_multiple_resources_fit.what_would_happen_if_they_did: the rule builds no scope (NONE_LINEAGE_AMBIGUOUS) and the row stays NON_SCORABLE; proven by a unit test that hands the rule two resources

A.name: Propagate the existing persisted resource fact through scope construction
A.why: the fact exists on every RawRecord, is immutable, is reachable by one join from any Evidence row, and needs no new authority; the smallest truthful implementation

B.name: Derive resource identity at scope-construction time from an immutable collector contract
B.why: no collector-to-resource contract is persisted; building one would be the collector-constant lookup table section 10 forbids, and it is unnecessary because A exists

C.name: Introduce a generic explicit measurement-resource binding relation
C.why: it would be a second authority for a fact acquisition.raw_records already represents canonically; section 9 forbids creating one

D.name: Do not repair because exact identity is not recoverable
D.why: identity is recoverable, explicitly, on 58 of 58 rows

implementation.rule: packages/evidence-reliability/python/sros_evidence_reliability/lineage.py: scope_from_lineage(source_id, claim_type, proposition_facts, lineage_resource_ids, lineage_record_kind_ids) builds the five-part scope when exactly one distinct resource and one distinct record kind are reachable, and refuses otherwise
consumers: infrastructure/scripts/run_opportunity_synthesis.py (late resolution replaces the column read; eligibility_at_citation and the reliability limitation are computed per row instead of hard-coded)

opportunity_limitation.limitation_text: Every supporting Evidence row is ELIGIBLE_CONTEXT, NON_SCORABLE and MISSING_RELIABILITY: no reviewed reliability applies, so this hypothesis can contribute to no score.
opportunity_limitation.why_stale: the detailed Wikimedia assessment (0.65) was created 2026-09-03T11:53Z and the convergent one (0.6) 2026-09-04T06:51Z, both after the revision; resolved late, 6 of the 7 linked rows carry a reviewed reliability
opportunity_limitation.how_it_is_reconciled: a new revision written by an attended synthesis run over the docker packet through the repaired path; that run is an LLM call, which this mission forbids, and it is a mission of its own
opportunity_limitation.pointer_shape: Mission 1.66.1: appended, rendered where the record has a page, nothing above the pointer changed

measurements.before_after_defined_as: before = the stored column the Opportunity path read; after = the late resolution through lineage. The database is identical on both sides.

remaining_limitation: The canonical Opportunity still carries a limitation that is false today, and reconciling it needs a new revision from an attended synthesis run. The seventh linked row, Stack Exchange, stays NON_SCORABLE because the operator declined that review, so the hypothesis can never be wholly scorable on this evidence. Every scorable Claim still has one provenance group, so the aggregator is still numerically the pass-through baseline and no calibration is unlocked. Scorable is not scored: no score exists.

recommended_next_mission.title: Opportunity Limitation Reconciliation V1

recommended_next_mission.why_this_and_not_globalping: the apparatus arc is parked on a semantic limit that no bounded move here changes; the canonical state that is knowingly false today is the Opportunity limitation, and that is the smallest truthful next move
recommended_next_mission.why_not_calibration: one provenance group per Claim, unchanged; Mission 1.43's arithmetic still governs
recommended_next_mission.what_it_must_not_do: persist a score, create an independence group, edit revision 1, or select a construct
